name: @type32/dispatcher
description: A type-safe, channel-based event dispatcher system for Nuxt with automatic cleanup and flexible event handling.

scripts.dev: bun run dev:prepare && bunx nuxi dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: bunx nuxt-module-build build --stub && bunx nuxt-module-build prepare && bunx nuxi prepare playground
scripts.release: bun run prepack && bunx changelogen --release && bun publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:types: bunx vue-tsc --noEmit && cd playground && bunx vue-tsc --noEmit
